usage: cli.py trace [-h] --strategy STRATEGY --explain EXPLAIN [--out OUT]
                    [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --strategy STRATEGY  Path to strategy JSON (or '-' for stdin)
  --explain EXPLAIN    Path to explain JSON (or '-' for stdin)
  --out OUT            Output trace JSON path (or '-' for stdout)
  --no-clobber         Fail if output file already exists.
